lede: The 2026 Asian Games medal table is the day's strongest cross-feed story, live on both Google Trends and Wikipedia at once, where it drew 293,009 views with India's results driving much of the search. The largest single number anywhere on the feeds sits apart from it: Case Keenum pulled 893,057 Wikipedia views, roughly 1.8 times the next article and unexplained by any other source. Two smaller stories also cross feeds today, the launch of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered on Steam and YouTube, and the explorer Ranulph Fiennes climbing on both search and Wikipedia.
